chapters.title: Opening the Black Box: Features as Directions
chapters.blurb: A real linear probe hunting a planted direction in activation space, and finding it at cosine 0.993.

chapters.title: Superposition: More Features than Neurons
chapters.blurb: The toy superposition model actually trained twice: dedicated dimensions when dense, a pentagon of shared ones when sparse.

chapters.title: Sparse Autoencoders: Unmixing the Stream
chapters.blurb: A real sparse autoencoder recovering every planted feature direction from the raw mixture, cosine 0.96 to 1.00.

chapters.title: Circuits: Algorithms You Can Read
chapters.blurb: A previous-token head composing with an induction head — every attention weight a real softmax, copying the repeat 9 of 9.

chapters.title: Ablation: Proof by Removal
chapters.blurb: Knock out either head and copying collapses to zero while the untouched behavior survives — proof by intervention, not by looking.
